licence: Mixed, and deliberately recorded as such. Four tiles come from Pexels photographs this repository already ships for the blog — free for commercial use, no attribution, no share-alike. The remaining six are Wikimedia Commons originals and are still copyleft: the tiles are cropped re-encodes, which makes them derivative works, so the share-alike terms attach to the tiles themselves. Credits are rendered at /credits.
note: Re-encoded to JPEG: a 560x480 carousel tile and a 1200x630 social card, both smart-cropped from the full-resolution original.
